title: Soir
identity: Pascal Proust, Soir, in the catalog’s Billaudot GB5758 edition. Billaudot lists E-flat and B-flat saxophone/piano classifications and labels its edition facile (cycle 1); Proust’s own page describes an alto saxophone and piano version, five minutes, cycle 2.

evidence.claim: Billaudot identifies Pascal Proust, GB5758, E-flat and B-flat saxophone/piano classifications, and facile cycle 1.
Composer site identifies alto saxophone and piano, five-minute duration, and cycle 2 (intermediate).

collection_flag: Publisher and composer give differing level descriptors (cycle 1 facile versus cycle 2 intermediate); retain both as edition/source claims and resolve before use.
gaps: No score or recording inspected; range and musical demands remain unknown.
proposed_corrections: Correct composer from Jean-Baptiste Proust to Pascal Proust. Verify whether the record should represent alto saxophone only or the Billaudot classifications for both E-flat and B-flat saxophones.
